single_ablation.implementation: For each immutable 15m, 30m and 60m STATE_PORTFOLIO config, change only scenario.mode to PERSISTENT_FLOW_ABSORPTION and the candidate label. All event, cross-market, boundary, confirmation, price geometry, cost, risk and execution fields remain byte-equivalent after normalizing those two metadata fields.
single_ablation.why_this_state: Every central 30m trade and all material losses were attributed to ACTIVE_FLOW_REVERSAL, while the persistent branch was inactive. This directly tests whether a viable failed-auction continuation-to-rotation mechanism remains after removing the harmful state rather than retuning its thresholds.

unchanged_variables: opening flow, turnover and return thresholds
fees, slippage, impact and funding allowance
decision_rule: A structural path exists only if the central 30m persistent-only rule and at least one adjacent 15m or 60m persistent-only rule pass every original weekly gate. Otherwise discard v90 and do not optimize thresholds.
